informal_statement: The type-\(\mathrm B\) auxiliary angle is \(\alpha=\beta+\arccos\lambda\).
reason: `CMVBallDefinitions.lean:11-13`: Lean defines \(\beta +\arccos (\lambda )\) for all real inputs. This is precisely the author's \(\alpha\), with its half-angle interpretation and \(0<\alpha \leq \pi\) restricted in the explanation to the admissible geometric domain.
